citation.title: Process-aware topology optimization leveraging deep learning surrogate model-based functions for laser powder bed fusion
citation.authors: Praveen S. Vulimiri, Shane Garner, Albert C. To
citation.version_coded: Abstract only; ScienceDirect full text returned HTTP 403

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: For the largest example, the abstract says the optimization converged in 2.5 days, faster than a single verification FEA that took 4 days.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: 4 days verification FEA / 2.5 days optimization = 1.6; abstract, largest example. This compares optimization duration with one verification simulation, as described in the abstract.
claim.alternatives: The abstract also claims the surrogate evaluates over 100 times faster than one FEA process simulation; comparison details are unavailable without full text.

baseline.classical_method: FEA-based process simulation and end-use application are mentioned; classical TO baseline is not specified in the accessible abstract
baseline.problem_size: Largest example has hundreds of thousands of design variables (abstract)
baseline.classical_time: 4 days for one verification FEA simulation (abstract; not established as classical TO runtime)
baseline.ml_time: 2.5 days convergence time for largest example (abstract)
baseline.quality_metric: End-use mechanical performance and residual distortion (abstract)
